prompt: What are causes for yellow marks on the eyelids
judge_reasoning: All candidates identify xanthelasma (cholesterol-rich eyelid deposits) as a key cause, but they differ greatly in reliability of additional claims. Candidate 1 stays closest to common, clinically plausible causes and recommends appropriate evaluation, while Candidate 2 introduces an unverifiable “85%” statistic and several less-supported nutritional/allergy causes. Candidate 3’s explanations (e.g., biliverdin buildup) and its added deficiencies/medications are not well-aligned with typical causes of yellow eyelid lesions, and Candidate 4 contains multiple highly dubious, specific demographic/age and liver-association claims that look fabricated. Overall, Candidate 1 is the most accurate and best focused.
